evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation (CASIC) 3rd Academy, 33 Research Institute”, a unit of China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation (CASIC); the list has named it since May 2001, under its current name since a 2019 revision. CASIC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and describes itself as the main force in building China’s defence weapons and equipment, making China’s full range of missile weapon systems.
It belongs to CASIC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.
